plain: Blindly and foolishly attached to a belief or plan

example.quote: Suppose the House of Representatives all equally infatuated, and determined on so wicked an intention as to infringe the rights of the people ; they have not the whole authority in their own hands.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 7, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
